convention: intronic 0-based half-open; converted by the probe to [start0+1, end0] 1-based inclusive
positive_control_note: Annotated exon 1 to exon 2 junction of NM_007029.4; excluded from the coverage gate.
cryptic_junction_note: STMN2 cryptic splicing uses the canonical exon-1 donor with a cryptic acceptor in intron 1, and the cryptic exon carries a premature polyadenylation signal, so the transcript terminates there. ONE cryptic junction, unlike UNC13A's two. Inclusion and exclusion therefore each contribute one junction, so cryptic/(cryptic+canonical) needs no per-junction correction.

derivation.method: Assembly offset anchored on two independent features of the same RefSeq transcript, then applied to the published hg19 cryptic-exon interval.
derivation.anchor_source: UCSC api.genome.ucsc.edu, track ncbiRefSeq, chr8:79000000-81000000, hg19 and hg38
derivation.match: The observed junction chr8:79611215-79616821 (1-based inclusive intron) places its acceptor exon start at 79616822, exactly the derived hg38 cryptic-exon start.
derivation.correction_to_the_plan: The prespecified criterion required annotated=0 for the cryptic junction. This junction is flagged annotated=1 in recount3's reference set, so that criterion would have wrongly excluded the true target. The literature cross-check overrode it. Five annotated=0 candidates that passed every structural check are recorded in reports/stmn2-derivation-20261111/derivation.json and are NOT the published event.
derivation.canonical_cross_check: The canonical junction chr8:79611215-79636801 matches exon 1 end and exon 2 start of NM_007029.4 exactly in hg38.

checks.A1_same_coordinates_both_tissues: PASS. Identical in motor cortex (row 2389629) and cervical cord (row 2415963).
checks.A2_cryptic_exon_is_terminal: Observation compatible with a terminal exon: no outgoing junction was reported at the queried boundary in these libraries. Nondetection does not establish absence or calibrate the ratio denominator; primary literature supports terminal processing.
checks.A3_rejected_candidates_negligible: PASS. The five annotated=0 candidates carry 1-2 reads each across 149 samples against 215 (cortex) and 484 (cord) for the sealed junction; they do not appear at all in cervical cord.
checks.A4_no_other_cryptic_event_missed: PARTIAL. Claude reported 34 unannotated junctions among 50 regional junctions, none above nine reads. 484/9 compares only that unannotated subset; annotation does not define all noncanonical events. Completeness is not established.
checks.A5_annotation_source_code: UNRESOLVED. The sealed junction carries right_annotated=cH38 and no documentation of that source code was available, so it is recorded without interpretation and was not guessed.

audit_20261111.incidental_finding: Three splice-donor coordinates (not three biological donors) were reported to share acceptor 79616821: canonical donor 484 reads, two alternatives four and three reads. No independent regional-matrix replay in integration.
audit_20261111.outcome: Coordinates retained. Regional observations do not establish exhaustiveness or an unbiased molecular fraction; see reports/integration-20261111/REVIEW.md.
